# Part IV: Working with Strings {.unnumbered}

Much audit data is text: names of vendors and beneficiaries, addresses, narrations in bank statements, and identifiers like PAN and GSTIN. This part teaches how to clean and manipulate text, how to describe patterns with regular expressions, how to validate Indian identifiers, including their check digits, and how to match names that are spelt differently.

The chapters in this part are:

- @sec-strng, manipulating text with stringr: cleaning names, reading bank narrations, restoring lost zeros.
- @sec-regex, regular expressions, and validating PAN, GSTIN, Aadhaar and other identifiers.
- @sec-rebus, writing regular expressions in readable form.
- @sec-strsim, fuzzy matching of names by spelling and by sound.
